topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: I can't believe it. Of all the teachers, it has to be her. Mrs. Thompson, with her prim wardrobe and lessons that felt like lectures at a museum. Her voice, so measured, as if every word was a step in a choreographed dance. Now, my child is stuck with her. The same smiling face, the same rigid rules. It’s like a cruel joke, a loop I can’t escape. I remember those days, the way she made everything feel so... small. And now my child, facing the same. I should have seen this coming, should have transferred him before the year even started. But no, I didn’t. Now, I have to watch and wait, hoping this time will be different.
